BiblicalUsage: In the New Testament, ekténeia is the word for intentness. In Acts 26:7, the text says "instantly serving [God] day and night."
TheologicalSignificance: Out of ekténeia I do not force more than it gives: intentness.
RelatedEvents: Paul Before Felix, Festus, and Agrippa
